concept.note: Yong is a software architecture label for the third synchronization lane; it does not assert a physical quantum phenomenon.

token_lanes.binding: dynamic verified Bankr registry at runtime
token_lanes.rule: No token is treated as active until chain, contract, symbol, decimals, liquidity/quote source and timestamp are verified.

gate_architecture.triad_mapping: Each applicable gate exposes three logical states: Yin authorization, Yang execution, Yong synchronization/reconciliation. Gate approval remains independent.

universal_placement.principle: Reusable architecture package across applicable OEQL/StellarNet/Poinhi interfaces and services.
universal_placement.copy_policy: Copies inherit the same schema and fail-closed rules but maintain independent runtime state and credentials.
universal_placement.render: dual spiral Yin/Yang fields with a central Yong reconciliation orbit
universal_placement.accessibility: text status, reduced motion, deterministic state indicators
